# Dart

The ultimate AI project management tool.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/dart/.

## Actions

- **Add Task Comment**: Create a new comment on a DART task.
- **Add Task Time Tracking**: Add a time tracking entry to a DART task.
- **Create Doc**: Create a new doc in Dart.
- **Create Task**: Create a new task in DART with title and optional metadata.
- **Delete Doc**: Move an existing doc to the trash where it can be recovered if needed.
- **Delete Task**: Delete an existing task in Dart by moving it to trash.
- **Get Doc** (read-only): Retrieve an existing doc with metadata and content.
- **Get Task** (read-only): Retrieve an existing task with full details including title, dartboard, status, and description.
- **Get User Space Configuration** (read-only): Retrieve workspace configuration including dartboards, folders, types, statuses, and more.
- **List Comments** (read-only): List comments for a task with filtering options.
- **List Tasks** (read-only): List tasks with powerful filtering options.
- **Move Task**: Move a task to a specific position within its dartboard.
- **Update Doc**: Update an existing doc in Dart.
- **Update Task**: Update an existing task in DART with new properties.
- **List Help Center Articles** (read-only): Search help center articles by semantic similarity to query.
- **Retrieve Skill By Title** (read-only): Retrieve a skill by its exact title from the workspace.
